thesis: The speaker describes his transition from an M&A lawyer to an investment banker at Goldman Sachs, where he worked on equity derivatives and convertible bond underwriting for four years before quitting to join Deal Breaker, a financial gossip blog. He explains that his move was driven by a desire to leave banking after realizing his senior role relied more on sales skills than his preferred technical work, and he notes that the blog hired him quickly because they perceived his risk of quitting as low.
